THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
101
Behind the image
81 / Camel Tailoring
REFERENCE 5956.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 058
Art direction: Warm camel and blush against a soft grey studio wall, a directional light stripe across
the background and a strong, poised silhouette.
Photorealistic vertical full-length studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with long,
glossy black wavy hair parted in the center, a calm, steady gaze and soft rose blush with glossy
rose lips, standing with her weight on one leg. She wears a camel-brown wool-look blazer with
peaked lapels, worn open over a fitted ribbed blush cardigan and a crisp striped cream button-up
shirt collar, a matching camel tailored short with a high waist, a slim silver rimless pair of glasses,
and a thin beaded necklace. Soft grey gradient studio backdrop with a diagonal soft light beam
across the wall and a light concrete floor, warm camel and blush palette, crisp tailoring, fine fabric
texture, polished autumn fashion editorial, no text or logos.
82 / Pleat Sport
REFERENCE 5957.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 058
Art direction: Sky blue, navy and white against a warm beige wall and grey railing, bright daylight,
a full-length, upright stance.
Photorealistic full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
long, straight dark hair parted in the center and a white padded headband, a composed, neutral
expression with soft red lips, standing upright and facing the camera. She wears a white
long-sleeve pullover with a navy zip-up collar, a pale sky-blue pleated mini skirt, bright cobalt-blue
ribbed knee-high leg warmers and white chunky platform loafers with gold buckles. She holds a
bright green wire practice basket of golf balls in one hand, with a black-handled golf club resting
against the railing beside her. Pale beige wall, grey metal railing, soft even daylight, white, navy
and sky-blue palette, crisp knit and pleat texture, sporty preppy campaign, no text or logos.
